title: 第十三章 亚枫的怒意
slug: 不正经的异世界攻略手册
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“哟！这不是亚枫吗！”

这时旁边走过俩人，一位戴着眼镜，棕色长发的女人，以及一个瘦瘦高高，头发乱糟糟的男人。

“安娜！乔治！最近怎么样？”亚枫很高兴的和俩人打招呼。

“还好啦，倒是你居然还活着啊，我还以为上周那个偷窥小学宿舍被抓到给打死丢河沟的那个人是你呢。”安娜笑哈哈的说道。

“开玩笑，我从来没被抓到过好不好。”亚枫说道。

俩人一起开着玩笑，打着招呼。

“对了，这位是...”安娜看向一边的伊尔莎。

“哦，我女儿，”亚枫说道。

“你们好...”伊尔莎打着招呼。

俩人看看伊尔莎，又看看亚枫，脸上露出了和之前普利斯一样的表情。

“话说，乔治这是怎么了？一副苦恼的摸样？”亚枫指着那位头发乱糟糟的男人问道。

“害，他啊。”安娜呵呵笑道，“最近因为书里的内容，被读者骂惨了。”

“写什么了？”

乔治叹了口气，开口道：“最近我在写同人文，但因为最后男主没有娶佩奇妈妈，现在读者全部在骂我是个漏女绿帽乌龟男，可恶，明明我都听他们的把菲菲公主给娶了，还这样骂我...”

“现在是这样的啦，男女主见面十秒不曹丕就算是养胃了，不如跟我写纯爱吧，只要专注一段甜甜的感情就好了。”亚枫说道。

“算了吧老前辈，现在单女主纯爱路边一条。”

“你他妈...”

安娜耸耸肩：

“其实我也跟他说，不如学学人家奥南尔换个赛道，那家伙在书里让男主被按着看女主被反派轮流侮辱读者都在叫好说真实感很足的。”

“哦牛批，他是写什么的？”亚枫好奇问道。

“武侠。”

“那不奇怪了。”

“可恶...如果他们之后还骂我，我就去肘击水泥地让他们愧疚一辈子！”乔治恨恨说道。

“去吧，但记得先让我撸点小贷。”亚枫说道。

“滚！”

“咳咳，别的先不说了，那个，你跪下，哥真得求你个事。”亚枫这时说道。

“什么？”俩人疑惑的看着他。

“你们能借我点钱吗？”亚枫问道。

"Hey! Isn't this Ya Feng!"

At this time, two people walked by, a woman with glasses and long brown hair, and a tall, thin man with messy hair.

"Anna! George! How are you doing?" Yafeng greeted the two of them happily.

"Fortunately, you're actually still alive. I thought you were the one who was caught peeping in the elementary school dormitory and was beaten to death and thrown into a ditch last week." Anna said with a smile.

"Just kidding, I've never been caught, okay?" Yafeng said.

The two of them joked and said hello together.

"By the way, this is..." Anna looked at Ilsa aside.

"Oh, my daughter," Yafeng said.

"Hello..." Ilsa greeted.

The two of them looked at Ilsa and then at Yafeng, with the same expression on their faces as Pulis before.

"By the way, what's wrong with George? Does he look distressed?" Yafeng asked, pointing at the man with messy hair.

"It's bad for him." Anna chuckled, "Recently, I have been scolded by readers because of the content in the book."

"What did you write?"

George sighed and said, "I have been writing fan fiction recently, but because the male protagonist did not marry Peppa Pig's mother in the end, all the readers are now calling me a cuckold. Damn it, I obviously listened to them and married Princess Feifei, but they still call me this..."

"Now it's like this. If the hero and heroine meet for ten seconds without Cao Pi, that's enough. Why don't you write about pure love with me? Just focus on a sweet relationship." Ya Feng said.

"Forget it, old-timer, now the single heroine is purely in love with the roadside."

"What the hell..."

Anna shrugged:

"Actually, I also told him that it would be better to follow the example of O'Nan'er and change the course. In the book, that guy had the male protagonist be held down while the female protagonist was insulted by the villain in turn. Readers praised it and said it was very realistic."

"Oh Niupi, what does he write about?" Yafeng asked curiously.

"Martial Arts."

"That's not surprising."

"Damn it... If they still scold me later, I will elbow them on the cement floor to make them feel guilty for the rest of their lives!" George said bitterly.

"Go, but remember to let me make some small loans first." Yafeng said.

"Get out!"

"Ahem, let's not talk about anything else. Well, kneel down. I really have to ask you a favor." Ya Feng said at this time.

"What?" The two looked at him doubtfully.

"Can you lend me some money?" Yafeng asked.
